title: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective - Reincarnation
description:
One of my SFC3 submissions, but without echo to make it work in SMW (included original SPC for completeness).
It's a calm happy song that could work for a cutscene or credits, I guess.
Not compatible with "Bonus End", P-Switch and Thunder SFX/Blarggs/Fireworks.
